# Cocktails
Oaxacan Sour: tobalá mezcal, lime, egg white, agave syrup  $15
Smoke & Mirrors: madrecuixe rinse, mezcal, mole bitters  $16
The Sierra Negra Negroni: sierra negra mezcal, campari, sweet vermouth  $17
Paloma Picante: tepextate, grapefruit soda, chile salt  $14
Our bar team travels to Oaxaca every year to find coyote and arroqueño mezcal for our guests, and we love sharing the story of every palenque we visit with everyone who walks in the door.
